description: Save a segment: a named rule over one audience that a campaign can target by segment_id. Resolved when a campaign starts, never stored as a list, so it stays current. For a migration, the usual first segment is the people the old provider rated engaged, tagged on import: send the new domain's first campaign to them, then widen. engaged_within_days is strict (opened, clicked or active in your product inside the window); exclude_unengaged_days keeps anyone added or never mailed inside it, which on a fresh import is everyone. A key already in use answers 409 conflict.

audience_id.description: The audience's id from list_audiences (a UUID), not its name. list_audiences maps each name to its id.

exclude_tags.description: Contacts carrying any of these are left out

key.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. "engaged"

properties.description: Custom property conditions, all of which must hold

tags.description: Contacts must carry every one of these tags

topic_key.description: Only people not opted out of this topic

name: create_segment
